meta.name: caveman-stats
meta.description: Show real token usage and estimated savings for the current session. Reads directly from the Claude Code session log — no AI estimation. Triggers on /caveman-stats. Output is injected by the mode-tracker hook; the model itself does not compute the numbers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查看当前会话的真实 token 用量与预估节省
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 Claude Code 并想了解实际 token 消耗与节省
copy.tagline_en: View real token usage and estimated savings for the current session
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Claude Code and want to see actual token consumption and savings

howto.what: 安装后，当你说出 /caveman-stats 时，Claude 会显示当前会话的真实 token 用量和预估节省。数据直接从 Claude Code 会话日志读取，不是 AI 估算。
howto.when: 当你在对话中输入 /caveman-stats 命令时触发。

say.text: 显示当前会话的 token 用量。
帮我看看这次会话节省了多少 token。

howto.what_en: When you say /caveman-stats, Claude shows real token usage and estimated savings for the current session. Data is read directly from the Claude Code session log, not AI-estimated.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type /caveman-stats in the conversation.

say_en.text: Show token usage for this session.
How many tokens did we save this session?
